companyFocus.name: Ecovacs
companyFocus.role: Consumer and commercial cleaning and lawn-robot developer
highlights: Consumer range includes DEEBOT floor cleaning, WINBOT glass cleaning and GOAT lawn mowing; ECOVACSCommercial separately describes K1 VAC andM1/M1 3D commercial cleaning platforms.

GOAT A3000 LiDAR PRO, A2000 LiDAR PRO andO1000 LiDAR PRO are separately named hardware models with TruEdge trimming, HoloScope 360 dual-LiDAR and AIVI 3D claims. Garage/blade accessory bundles are not extra robot models.
Commercial tables retain task-specific endurance, roller width, theoretical area rate and clean/recovery tank capacity. K1 charging and area-rate disagreements are exposed rather than averaged.
WINBOT robot mass, portable station battery duration, power-off protection, water tank and area-time rate are separate quantities. Exterior-window use retains the manual tether/weather conditions.
US product prices and stock are dated regional observations. OriginalA3000 out-of-stock status is not inherited byPRO models; model-selector/accessory prices are not substituted for the main product.
Navigation, obstacle avoidance, edge cutting and productivity remain manufacturer claims; no independently verified exclusivity, zero-risk guarantee or complete historical portfolio asserted.
The current US DEEBOT range adds T80 OMNI, X8 PRO OMNI, X9 PRO OMNI and X11 OmniCyclone with OZMO roller mopping, TruEdge edge cleaning and OMNI stations.
The reviewed DEEBOT pages publish 6,400 mAh batteries, 18,000 to 19,500 Pa suction, 4 h 37 min or less charging and 297 min or less silent sweep runtime.

source-integrity-check.inspection: Native HTML read as text only. No research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions.

body-scope-check.versionScopes: DEEBOT X2 Omni, X5 Pro Omni, T50 Pro Omni and X12 OmniCyclone are four separate current ECOVACS models. The catalog rows are separate entries, not configurations of one model.
body-scope-check.priceScopes: None of the four reviewed pages publishes a robot price in the extracted native text; the catalog ~1,500, 1,299, 399 and 1,499 USD values are not confirmed. Page price strings are not substituted from accessory prices.
body-scope-check.weightScopes: The X2 Omni page publishes about 5 kg robot net weight against the catalog ~4.5 kg, the T50 Pro Omni page 3.7 kg, the X12 OmniCyclone page 5.5 kg. The X5 Pro Omni specification block publishes no robot net weight, so the catalog ~4.5 kg is cleared.
body-scope-check.sizeScopes: Robot dimensions are 320 x 353 x 95 mm for the X2 Omni, 313 x 346 x 95 mm for the X5 Pro Omni, 352.7 x 351.6 x 81 mm for the T50 Pro Omni and 353 x 351 x 98 mm for the X12 OmniCyclone. Station dimensions are separate and not merged into robot size.
body-scope-check.payloadScopes: No reviewed page publishes a payload rating; these are cleaning appliances without a manipulator or load rating.
body-scope-check.enduranceScopes: Battery capacity is 6,400 mAh for the X2 Omni, X5 Pro Omni and T50 Pro Omni and 4,000 mAh for the X12 OmniCyclone. Published runtimes are silent/standard sweep and sweep-and-mop minutes. The X2 Omni page gives only a relative charging statement. The X12 OmniCyclone silent-sweep figure of 5,461 min over 5,236 m2 is implausible for a 4,000 mAh battery and is not recorded.
body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: ECOVACS describes OZMO Turbo 2.0, AIVI/dToF navigation, mop lifting and OMNI stations. These are manufacturer descriptions, not independent safety certification or proof of unsupervised operation.
body-scope-check.listingScopes: The roboticsdir and buyandrentrobots listings name products and companies; they do not establish prices, current stock, delivered fleets or independent performance.

comparison-evidence-check.scope: Exact claim/source/status delivery; runtime tests separately verify comparison rendering and load behavior.
